# Live WAF baseline (monitor): tools/loadtest -variants -hardening -formats-mode monitor, with the format checks
# only monitoring, as on a site that does not set them.
# The attack templates listed under [admitted attacks] reach the origin and the benign controls listed under
# [refused controls] are refused. Every other attack must be refused and every other control forwarded, and every
# entry must still hold: check_live_report.py fails on a change in either direction, so what is blocked now stays
# blocked. Each listed attack must also raise an alert (loadtest -alert-probe). After a deliberate change, regenerate
# this file from the Security review run's report:
#   python3 .github/security/check_live_report.py REPORT .github/security/live-waf-baseline-monitor.txt --write
